theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cipi_slice_integer_multiplicity
theorems.statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1)), A t ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), B t η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) {x | f x = t} → (A t).boundary η = B t η) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen W → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}))) → ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P) (θ₀ : ℝ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)), Orthonormal ℝ v → 0 < θ₀ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = θ₀ * ∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) : Set (Euclid P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) y v ∂μHE[(d + 1)]) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (C).boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B)) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∃ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, IsIntegerMultiplicity Z ∧ ∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, Z φ = θ₀ * ∫ y in {y : Euclid P | y - t • v 0 ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.tail v))}, (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y (Fin.tail v) ∂μHE[d]
